statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the watch threshold while NQ is closed for the weekend; Stress remains high on rate repricing and geopolitical reopening risk.

headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while rates and Hormuz keep Stress high
body: Friday closed with U.S. technology under pressure after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced the inflation fight. Fresh shared Finviz context collected at 02:28 UTC shows NQ down 0.69% on the latest session, all seven tracked semiconductors negative, but five of eight megacaps positive; Hormuz restrictions remain an unresolved reopening-gap risk.

outlookSummary: All 24 forecast hours are inside the weekend NQ closure. Tail stays low because no live one-way path can form, while Stress remains high from Friday's yield repricing, semiconductor weakness and Hormuz uncertainty. Next-week risk centers on September 1-4 labor, ISM and Fed checkpoints outside this 24-hour horizon.
